parameters.name: PassthroughClient
parameters.description: {{reference}} Indicates whether this {{object}} entry is configured for passthrough. If {{param}} is specified, and the referenced client (since boot) has received a value from an associated upstream DHCPv6 server for the given {{param|Tag}} option, then the referenced client's option value will be sent instead of {{param|Value}}. Otherwise, {{param|Value}} will be sent. {{empty}} indicates that passthrough is not configured for this {{object}} entry.

object.description: This object specifies the DHCPv6 options that MUST, if enabled, be offered to clients whose DHCPv6 requests are associated with this pool. If {{param|PassthroughClient}} is specified, and the referenced client has a value for a given option then the {{param|PassthroughClient}} option value will be sent instead of {{param|Value}}. Otherwise, {{param|Value}} will be sent.
